59:17.text: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.

59:18.text: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.

59:19.text: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.

59:20.text: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers

59:21.text: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

59:22.text: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed.
He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

59:23.text: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign,
Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

59:24.text: to Him belong the best names.
Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
